strongest_angle: Examining the federal antitrust lawsuit filed by Newsmax Broadcasting against Fox Corp and Roku over Fox's $22 billion acquisition, which alleges an unlawful monopoly over the free ad-supported streaming television market.

key_facts.fact: Newsmax Broadcasting filed a federal antitrust lawsuit in San Jose challenging Fox Corp.'s $22 billion acquisition of Roku.
According to the complaint filed by Newsmax, the combined entity of Fox and Roku will control approximately 70% of the free, ad-supported streaming TV market.
The Department of Justice cleared the $22 billion acquisition earlier in November after Fox made commitments regarding Roku operating as an open platform.

numbers.label: Estimated free ad-supported streaming TV market control
